TIMETABLE EFFECTIVE MARCH 1, 1988

"Y"
FlightFUND?
It saves you
up to 200
on First Class.
Now, you can fly First Class without paying
for it. Its called America West's "Y FlightFUND"
fare. To get it, all America West FlightFUND
members have to do is ask when making their
reservations to or from Chicago, New York
or Baltimore/Washington.
It's good for up to $200 off! Just travel by
May 20th, 1988
Now you know why FlightFUND. If youre
not already a member, heres how you can become
one. Just pick up an application at an America West
ticket counter or when making your reservations.
Just call your Travel Agent or America West at
800-247-5692.
VAmerica West.
Our low fare comes with more care.
America West Airlines, 222 South Mill Avenue, Tempe, Arizona 85281
AWA #960315 2003, 105, 024.
Printed in USA 200M 3/88

NOW A GREAT DEAL
TO LAS VEGAS
OR RENO
IS A SURE BET.
Introducing AmeriWest Vacations.
When you book a vacation package to
Las Vegas or Reno with AmeriWest Vacations,
you get a great deal of flexibility. A great deal of
convenience. And a great deal for the money.
You see, unlike other package vacations, your
departure is not limited to certain flights
on certain days. You can book your roundtrip
on any America West flight on any day of
the week.
And your total package price will even
entitle you to triple FlightFUND™dollars on
America West's frequent flyer program
throughout 1988.
What's more, you can choose from the
finest hotels in Las Vegas and Reno. Then, with
just one phone call, you can book your
accommodations, along with air and optional
ground transportation, as little as three days
prior to departure.
Plus, in most cases, our package price is
lower than if you purchased each service
separately.
For reservations, call your Travel Agent or
AmeriWest Vacations. Were open evenings
and weekends to take your call. 1-800-356-6611.
In Phoenix 921-0221.
AMERIVEST
VACATIONS
A DIVISION OF AMERICA WEST AIRLINES
